title: feat(plugin-auth): opt-in Cloudflare Turnstile on email sign-up
body:
domain:server#3 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cxKwptVz3gdUgWLyNb
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D825P5cyzb4mXdkgvzukAp1)_

Fixes #28100

Clause-②: yes (widening: the public auth config gains `features.turnstileSiteKey`, served only while the challenge is on; `PUBLIC_AUTH_CONFIG_NON_FLAG_KEYS` and `AuthFeaturesConfigSchema` gain `turnstileSiteKey`; with the challenge on, `/sign-up/email` answers better-auth's `captcha` refusals `400 MISSING_RESPONSE`, `403 VERIFICATION_FAILED` and `500 UNKNOWN_ERROR`; two new env vars `OS_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY` / `OS_TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY`; `@object-ui/auth` gains `TurnstileWidget`, `TURNSTILE_SCRIPT_URL`, the `TurnstileApi`/`TurnstileWidgetProps`/`TurnstileWidgetLabels` types, `RegisterForm`'s `turnstileSiteKey` prop and `captchaFailed`/`captchaRetry` labels, `SignUpData.captchaToken` and a fifth `signUp` argument; `@object-ui/app-shell` gains `signUpCaptchaFailedMessage`)
Metadata-protocol: added
Ruling-ref: maintainer 「同意 A」 on cloud#3367 (2026-10-30 12:46Z); triage 6523361600; one-PR exception extended by triage 6524682167 and 6527231164 (on retriage 6523679528 and 6526181490)

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：同时配置 `OS_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY` 和 `OS_TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY` 时，邮箱注册（`/sign-up/email`）需要通过 Cloudflare Turnstile 校验；Console 的注册页和首次安装页会显示验证组件并带上 token。只配一个或都不配，行为与现在完全一样。
- 为什么改：公开发布前防止批量注册 Free 账号刷模型费用（cloud#3367 选项 A）。
- 风险与回滚：默认关闭；开启后只拦注册，登录与重置密码不拦（better-auth 默认也会拦这两个，已显式覆盖）。secret 不下发、不进日志、不进错误响应（有测试钉住）。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/turnstile-sign-up.ts`，`ui/packages/auth/src/TurnstileWidget.tsx`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run src/turnstile-sign-up.test.ts`，预期 12 passed（需先构建 plugin-auth 依赖闭包）。
- 需要你做的：无；席位安排契约复审后落地。cloud 那半边（配密钥、staging 验收）是 cloud 的卡。

## File surface

Exactly the surface triage granted: 6523361600 (plugin-auth, the app-shell sign-up widget, the Console CSP file, one docs line, changeset), extended by 6524682167 and 6527231164.

- Server: `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/{turnstile-sign-up.ts (new), auth-manager-plugin-list.ts, auth-manager.ts}`
- Spec (6524682167 item 1): `packages/spec/src/kernel/public-auth-features.ts`, `packages/spec/src/api/auth-endpoints.zod.ts`
- `@object-ui/auth` (6524682167 item 2, 6527231164 item 1): `ui/packages/auth/src/{types.ts, createAuthClient.ts, AuthProvider.tsx, AuthContext.ts, RegisterForm.tsx, TurnstileWidget.tsx (new), index.ts}`
- Console pages (6524682167 items 2-3): `ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/{RegisterPage.tsx, SetupPage.tsx}`
- app-shell (6523361600; 6527231164 item 2): `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/auth/{RegisterPage.tsx, signUpRefusalMessages.ts}`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/index.ts`
- i18n (6527231164 item 3, two keys each): `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/{ar,de,en,es,fr,ja,ko,pt,ru,zh}.ts`
- CSP (6524682167 item 4): `packages/cli/src/utils/console.ts`
- Docs (6527231164 item 4, one row): `content/docs/deployment/environment-variables.mdx`
- Ride-alongs (6527231164): generated `packages/spec/authorable-surface/api.json` and `content/docs/references/api/auth-endpoints.mdx`; tests `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/turnstile-sign-up.test.ts`, `packages/cli/src/utils/console.content-security-policy.test.ts`, `ui/packages/auth/src/__tests__/registerTurnstile-28100.test.tsx`, `ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/__tests__/{turnstileWidget-28100.test.tsx, authExitBasename.test.tsx, setupCreateTimezone-11908.test.tsx}`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/auth/__tests__/defaultRegisterTurnstile-28100.test.tsx`; `.changeset/28100-turnstile-sign-up.md`

## What changes

**Server (`@objectstack/plugin-auth`).**
- `src/turnstile-sign-up.ts` (new): `resolveTurnstileKeys()` returns both keys only when both env vars are set and non-blank; it is the one decision the plugin mount and the public config share. `buildTurnstileSignUpPlugin()` builds better-auth's `captcha` plugin with provider `cloudflare-turnstile` and `endpoints: ['/sign-up/email']`. better-auth's own default list also guards `/sign-in/email` and `/request-password-reset`; it is overridden because neither form has a widget, so the vendor default would refuse every password sign-in on a deployment that turned this on. `reportHalfConfiguredTurnstile()` warns once per build when exactly one variable is set, naming the variables only.
- `src/auth-manager-plugin-list.ts`: mounts the plugin right after `bearer()` when both keys are set. It is a plain `plugins.push`, not an optional plugin: a guard that fails to build fails the build rather than leaving sign-up open while the Console renders a widget.
- `src/auth-manager.ts`: `getPublicConfig()` serves `features.turnstileSiteKey` (the public key only) from the same resolver.
- The plugin hooks the router's `onRequest` stage after the per-address rate limit, so a refused request reads and writes nothing. Server-side `auth.api.signUpEmail` callers (the development admin seed, demo staff) do not pass that stage and are unaffected. The client address Cloudflare receives as `remoteip` is the one `handleRequest` establishes by the platform's trust rule.

**Spec (`@objectstack/spec`).** `PUBLIC_AUTH_CONFIG_NON_FLAG_KEYS` gains `turnstileSiteKey` (the plugin-auth drift guard holds served = declared), and `AuthFeaturesConfigSchema` gains `turnstileSiteKey: z.string().optional()`. The generated `authorable-surface/api.json` and `content/docs/references/api/auth-endpoints.mdx` are regenerated.

**Console CSP (`@objectstack/cli`, `src/utils/console.ts`).** While both variables are set, the Console document's policy adds `https://challenges.cloudflare.com` to `script-src` and adds `frame-src 'self' https://challenges.cloudflare.com`. With the challenge off the policy is byte-identical to today. The two names are restated there because the published `./console` subpath imports Node built-ins only; only presence is read.

**Console (`ui/`).**
- `@object-ui/auth`: `TurnstileWidget` loads Cloudflare's script once in explicit-render mode, hands its token up, and on failure, expiry, timeout or a script that cannot load shows one retry message with a Retry button, never Cloudflare's error code. `RegisterForm` takes `turnstileSiteKey`; with it, the form renders the widget, holds submit until it is solved, sends the token, and draws a fresh challenge after every server answer (tokens are single-use). A server refusal `MISSING_RESPONSE` / `VERIFICATION_FAILED` reads as the same retry message. `createAuthClient.signUp` sends `SignUpData.captchaToken` as the `x-captcha-response` header, never in the body.
- `/register` (`ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/RegisterPage.tsx`) and the exported `DefaultRegisterPage` (`ui/packages/app-shell`) pass `features.turnstileSiteKey`.
- `/setup` (`ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/SetupPage.tsx`): the first owner registers through the same `/sign-up/email` door, so without the widget there a deployment that turned the challenge on before its first owner could not be set up. It reads the config, renders the widget and sends the token the same way.
- `@object-ui/i18n`: `auth.register.captchaRetry` and `auth.register.errors.captchaFailed` in all ten locales.

**Docs.** One row in `content/docs/deployment/environment-variables.mdx` naming the two variables.

## Why

The maintainer ruled option A on cloud#3367: a Turnstile check on sign-up at the framework layer, because cloud's sign-up page is plugin-auth plus the Console. Triage graded it opt-in and byte-identical when off.

Scope notes, measured on `main` `b6c2ed9c`:
- The card named `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/auth/RegisterPage.tsx`; the Console's live `/register` is `ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/RegisterPage.tsx`, and both draw `@object-ui/auth`'s `RegisterForm`, where the token has to be sent. The first-run `/setup` page posts the same endpoint. Triage extended the one-PR exception to these files and the two spec lines (6524682167, 6527231164).
- Sign-in and password reset are left unchallenged, as the card asks; this PR has no measurement that says they need it.
- No `allowedHostnames` or `expectedAction` is set: Cloudflare already ties a token to its site key's domains, and neither has a configuration surface in the card.

## Verification

- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/turnstile-sign-up.test.ts` (12, real engine, Cloudflare's siteverify stubbed through `fetch`, no network): ON, a sign-up without a token is `400 MISSING_RESPONSE` with no user row and no Cloudflare call; a token is verified with the secret and the account is created; a rejected token is `403 VERIFICATION_FAILED` with no row; Cloudflare unreachable is `500` and the secret is in neither the body nor any log line. Sign-in and password reset need no token. OFF (neither key, only one, a blank secret): sign-up with no token succeeds, Cloudflare is never called, no site key is served; a half configuration warns naming the missing variable. The config serves the site key, never the secret, and the key is in the spec registry.
- Ablations (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`): dropping the plugin mount reds the four ON cases; dropping the endpoint override reds the sign-in/reset case; dropping the header in `createAuthClient` reds the two wire cases.
- `packages/cli/src/utils/console.content-security-policy.test.ts` (50): both keys set admits Cloudflare in `script-src` and `frame-src` and carries neither value; neither key, one key or a blank secret leaves the policy unchanged.
- `ui/packages/auth/src/__tests__/registerTurnstile-28100.test.tsx` (4, on the wire through the real `AuthProvider` and `createAuthClient`): no key, no widget and no header; with a key, submit waits for the challenge and the token goes out as `x-captcha-response`; a failed or expired challenge shows the retry message, not the provider code; a refused token reads as the retry message and the challenge is redrawn.
- `ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/__tests__/turnstileWidget-28100.test.tsx` (4) and `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/auth/__tests__/defaultRegisterTurnstile-28100.test.tsx` (2): `/register`, `/setup` and `DefaultRegisterPage` render the widget exactly when the key is served. Two existing `/setup` test doubles gain `getAuthConfig`.
- `pnpm --filter <pkg> typecheck` green for plugin-auth, cli and spec. Every family `dispatch-gates --commands` derives was run and reconciled with `--ran`, plus `pnpm lint`, on `main` `a0f86549`: 113 of 113 derived families exit 0 (0 NOT MEASURED), and `pnpm lint` exits 0. UI `type-check` for the touched packages and their console (74 tasks), `check:i18n-keys` and `check:i18n-drift` exit 0 (measured on the pre-rebase base `b6c2ed9c`; CI re-runs them).

Skills-docs: `grep -rniE "captcha|turnstile" skills content/docs` finds only `content/docs/ui/forms.mdx` (embeddable public forms, a different surface) and the new environment-variables row; nothing in `skills/` describes sign-up's request shape. None owed.
